exposure: Oophoropexy using trocar site closure needle
outcome: Normal Doppler flow of target ovary
Normal shape and free mobility of ovary
cohort: Seven patients presented with ovarian torsion, including four pregnant women (7-20 weeks gestation), two patients with ovarian hyperstimulation, and one adolescent with a hemorrhagic cyst.
finding: The use of a trocar site closure needle for oophoropexy in ovarian torsion is an easier, faster, and more comfortable technique, especially in pregnant women and those with hyperstimulated ovaries.
mod_finding: Two pregnant women who underwent cesarean delivery had their operated ovary observed during delivery, and it was found to be normal in shape, freely mobile, and without adhesions.
gest_age: 7, 15, 19, and 20 weeks of gestation (for pregnant participants)
